notes.title: New Level on Demo version
notes.notes:
Hey, guys! We have a new level on the demo of the game! It was supposed to be released with the other levels, but we had to made some adjustments first, so we decided to wait and add it later. But now you can play it! 

You just need to play the 7th level again to unlock the new level (sorry, I couldn't find a way to make it easier for those who already completed all the levels (-_-" )).
